|lore=Member of Imperial Intelligence, Internal Security division. Assigned by IntSec to ''Executor''. Responsible for the physical safety of Imperial personnel against Rebel saboteurs.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at an ''Executor'' site, may use 1 Force to place a just lost non-unique smuggler (and all copies of that card in opponent’s Lost Pile) out of play. At same non-docking bay site, opponent may not deploy Jar Jar or spies.

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Corporal Derdram (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Corporal Derdram (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The cutout of the original slip preserves the Warrior icon of the [[:File:Dagobah-D-corporalderdram-decipher-archive.gif|underlying Decipher card]]. The later slip prints a standalone Pilot icon as well as Warrior. Both include the P2 piloting bonus in their game text. The period rules distinguish an icon outside the game text from a piloting bonus printed inside it. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=84 Pilot rules and icon]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=95 Virtual slips and printed pilot bonuses].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 3, slip 31. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Corporal Derdram]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf first release sheet of 30 May 2003] and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf revised sheet labeled 19 June 2003] (old pre-Remaster slips).
|hatnote=This is the current (Remaster) text of this Virtual Original card. For the original 30 May 2003 slip, see [[Corporal Derdram (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Corporal Derdram]].
